purpose: Defines requirements for a staged, step-by-step version migration framework that keeps versioned data formats backward compatible by converting old-version data to the current version.
summary: Overview of the staged migration framework for backward compatibility
Scope: data formats with major version numbers and structural changes between versions
FR-01 version detection, treating missing identifier as oldest version v1
FR-02 stepwise migration via a registry keyed by target version, chained execution
FR-03 migration function conventions: idempotent, side-effect free
FR-04 error handling: propagate exceptions, no silent fallback, skip unknown future versions
FR-05 extensibility: add one function and update the current version constant (Open-Closed)
Non-functional requirements: in-memory only, standard library only
Design pattern code sample and procedure for adding a new version
Glossary of terms such as current_version and detected_version
tasks: Designing or implementing versioned data format migration
Adding a new version to .doc_structure.yaml migration
Reviewing error handling in migration code
title: COMMON-REQ-001: 段階的バージョンマイグレーション要件定義書
